steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: TCP/IP: App (HTTP, DNS, FTP), Transport (TCP reliable, UDP fast), Internet (IP routing), Link (Ethernet, WiFi)

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: TCP: 3-way handshake, sequencing, flow control, congestion control; UDP: connectionless, low latency

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: DNS: hierarchical (root, TLD, authoritative); recursive/iterative queries; records (A, AAAA, MX, CNAME)

steps.title: Worked example
steps.body: Q: Explain the TLS handshake process --- Solution: 1. Client hello (supported ciphers). 2. Server hello (chosen cipher) + certificate (public key, CA signed). 3. Client verifies cert (CA trusted, not expired, domain matches). 4. Client generates pre-master secret, encrypts with server public key, sends. 5. Both derive session keys. 6. Encrypted communication begins
